notes: Checks in order limit > exchange > sector > cursor (000142, 000143, 000677-000680).
Empty exchange/sector/cursor are ignored; an empty limit is invalid (000125-000128).
limit parses like Pydantic lax ints ('05', '+5', ' 5', '3.0' accepted; '1.5', '1e1' refused; 000836).
Filters are case-insensitive exact matches; a repeated parameter uses its last value (000124).
Cursor = base64url (no padding) of {"after":"<symbol>"}; decoding tolerates padding and spaces, the symbol is matched case-insensitively and must exist (else invalid_cursor, 000139).
total counts all matches regardless of the cursor; next_cursor is null on the last page.

notes: Credentials in the api_key query parameter (X-API-Key header ignored, 000012). Bad credentials: the socket is accepted then closed 4401 with the reason 'Missing api_key query parameter.' / 'Invalid API key.' / 'This API key has been revoked.' (000501-000505); the handler authenticates (auth exempt here) to send those reasons.

subscribe -> subscribed (symbols upper-cased, de-duplicated) then 5 rounds of one quote per symbol ~252 ms apart, then done and close 1000; messages during the rounds are ignored; errors keep the socket open.

relations.name: ticker_exchange
relations.evidence: 60 of 60 tickers' exchange is an exchange code; docs: 'exchange is an exchange code'.
relations.rules_evidence: Every exchange lists tickers (XNAS 19, XNYS 16, XTKS 7, XLON 7, XHKG 6, XPAR 5; GET /v1/tickers?exchange=...). Neither collection can be written through the API (no write routes; OPTIONS /v1/exchanges -> 405 Allow: GET, 000044), so on_missing/on_delete never apply; set to the conservative refuse/restrict.

relations.name: quote_ticker
relations.evidence: Quotes recorded for all 60 tickers (14-quotes-all); unknown symbols -> 404 ticker_not_found.
relations.rules_evidence: Every ticker has a quote (60 of 60 recorded). Quotes and tickers are read-only, so the write rules never apply.

relations.name: watchlist_symbols
relations.evidence: Every symbol stored in a watchlist is a ticker symbol (upper-cased on write).
relations.rules_evidence: on_missing=refuse: POST/PUT/PATCH with an unknown symbol -> 400 unknown_symbol (000245, 000273, 000287). min_per_target=0: tickers need no watchlist (the real API starts with none). on_delete: tickers cannot be deleted (no route), so it never applies.

notes: Real API: FauxCall Reference Market API 1.0.0 (local, http://127.0.0.1:9100). Recorded 2026-10-15 00:31-01:10 UTC.
The MCP server the docs mention at /mcp is not part of this REST fake (a fake is either REST or MCP).

429 rate_limited body is NOT recorded: probing a rate limit needs the user's explicit approval, which the answers (writes only) don't give; code/message are a guess in the documented error shape. Limits, headers and Retry-After follow the docs and the recorded X-RateLimit-* headers.
Calendars: no weekend or holiday was observable while recording (Thursday 00:31-02:00 UTC); weekdays-only and no holidays follow the docs ('follows its exchange's trading sessions'), unverified.

Method-not-allowed probes with write methods (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE on read-only paths) were not approved; 405 evidence comes from OPTIONS/HEAD: under /v1 (000043, 000044, 000831-000833) and outside it (000854-000857), where Allow is sent with no key check or rate limit, and is empty at /openapi.json.
